page.notes: The Hebrew line at the head could not be read and is marked illegible. The Greek and Hebrew in the text were checked against the scan. Long s is plain s throughout. Printed spelling was kept, including "Pontificijs" (normalised to "Pontificiis"), "Gracis", and "euincendam". The printed forms "fanæ" and "infanire" were read as "sanæ" and "insanire" from the long-s pattern. The page has no margin notes, and the light stains and show-through were left out.
